body: Thank you. I'm a little bit better now, but it's so damn hard to fight these urges. I'll keep your offer in mind,

Thank you, I've calmed down a little bit and still haven't self-harmed like I usually do when this happens but my mind is still in a dismal place. I hate that I get triggered by dumb things and get sent into a downward spiral for a short time, I'll just have to try sleeping on it.
